name: Profane

index.rulebook: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
On command the weapon is sheathed in negative energy until commanded again. A living wielder takes 1 Constitution damage each round the energy is active. A hit deals an extra 1d6 damage to a living creature, or 2d6 to a good outsider. While energized, the weapon is evil for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. Bows, crossbows, and slings place the effect on their ammunition.

Prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, inflict light wounds.

name: Profane Burst

index.rulebook: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
This is a profane weapon that also bursts with negative energy on a critical hit, even if the target is immune to critical hits. The burst deals 1d4 Constitution damage to a living wielder. On a critical hit the weapon deals an extra 1d10 damage to a living creature (2d10 if the multiplier is x3, 3d10 if it is x4). Double those dice against a good outsider. The critical-hit damage applies even when the profane energy is not active. Bows, crossbows, and slings place the effect on their ammunition.

Prerequisites: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, inflict critical wounds.

name: Ghost Net

index.rulebook: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
Thrown as a net, but it only affects incorporeal creatures. A hit does not entangle the target. Instead the creature is treated as corporeal when it takes damage: normal weapons can hit it (its damage reduction still applies) and it does not have the 50% chance to ignore damage from a corporeal source. It also cannot turn ethereal, or return from the Ethereal Plane if caught there. Its other special abilities remain. Escaping is a DC 20 Escape Artist check (a full-round action). Strength cannot burst the net.

Prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, ghost trap.

The attack can be delivered as part of an unarmed strike, slam, claw, or similar hand attack, but that attack is a normal attack rather than a touch attack. The gauntlets do nothing if the wearer is a construct or undead.

Prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, ghoul touch.

name: Husk Globe

index.rulebook: Libris Mortis: The Book of Undead

description_html:
A preserved humanoid corpse in a glass or crystal globe. Running a hand over the globe and commanding the occupant by its correct name lets the questioner ask up to ten questions. Answers are telepathic and audible to everyone within 30 feet. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it spoke. Answers may be brief, cryptic, or repetitive. The globe can be activated once per week. If told new information while active, it can repeat that information later.

Prerequisites: Craft Wondrous Item, speak with dead. Weight 700 lb.
